feedback.problem: Find the largest interval of continuity for the function $f(x)=\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{3x-12}{{x}^{2}+1}).$
feedback.worked_solution:
Our function is a logarithmic function, so it is continuous over all points in its domain.

To find the domain of $\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{3x-12}{{x}^{2}+1}),$ we set the expression under the logarithm to be greater than zero:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3x-12}{{x}^{2}+1}>0\,⟹\,3x-12>0\,⟹\,x>4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the domain of $f(x)=\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{3x-12}{{x}^{2}+1})$ is $(4,\infty ),$ and it is also continuous on this interval.
